title: Normalized affine and localized-presentation deformation comparisons
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $A$ a $k$-algebra. Use the actual arrow $\operatorname{Spec}A\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, its algebra arrow and the associated sheaf functor. Affine comparison data consist of canonical ring squares to all local section arrows, normalized by inverse-image units and regular-function restrictions; a chain map from the associated sheaf of the full standard ring cotangent complex to the standard sheaf cotangent complex, an isomorphism in the derived category equal to this chain map after localization, and the formula on every standard local section. The coefficient comparison $\mathcal O_X\otimes_k M\cong\widetilde{A\otimes_kM}$ sends the pulled-back section $m$ to $1\otimes m$. Define the affine Ext comparison by exact associated sheafification, its canonical derived comparisons, and these normalized isomorphisms. For a localized polynomial presentation use the recorded projection from the full cotangent complex to the actual two-term complex, followed by this Ext comparison. For an algebra arrow $q:A\to B$ fixing $k$, coefficient restriction sends $a\otimes m$ to $q(a)\otimes m$; a pair of full cotangent Ext classes restricts compatibly when postcomposition by this map equals precomposition by the cotangent map followed by derived restriction of scalars and its canonical shift and single-module comparisons. Dependencies: [def-sfb-scheme-lift-classification-data], [lem-trf-lci-cotangent-presentation], [lem-trf-lci-naive-cotangent-model], [lem-sc-tilde-preserves-finite-limits].
